svg.title: Campus Cards · Set 03 · Davis · 06/12 Class Change (Uncommon)
svg.desc: The hour turns and the bike paths fill edge to edge. Signal, hold your line, keep pedaling. Unofficial. An independent PointCast art project about places. Not affiliated with, sponsored by, or endorsed by the University of California or any campus. No university logos, seals, mascots, or marks are used.
